images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: entirely NEW Dragon Database form-card fury illustration.
Primary request: an original mature, powerful, BADASS and FEROCIOUS dragon individual, from fresh text-only generation. Give it intimidating predatory eyes, exposed fangs, muscular scaled anatomy and forceful action. Each named design is a different individual in a completely different scene, not a recolor or pose edit of another.
Style/medium: sophisticated richly colored fantasy storybook painting, gouache and watercolor texture with fine ink-like scale detail, expressive shapes, cinematic rim light and layered atmosphere. Hand-painted illustration, not a photograph or 3D.
Composition/framing: landscape 5:3 full-bleed, one complete dragon occupying roughly 65–80% of the frame. Crisp prominent central silhouette and sharp detailed face/body against a quieter softer painted epic background. Strong light/dark and warm/cool subject separation. Fit the whole creature, tail, horns and all wings if applicable inside the frame. Keep 8–10% breathing room from every extremity to the image edges for a shallow card crop; do not clip wing tips.
Constraints: precisely follow form anatomy below. No extra creatures or people, no gore, no text, typography, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, frames or interface. No generic dragon substitutions. Keep the intimidating face and defining anatomy unobscured by background effects.
Scene: pale ochre DESERT RUINS, broad softly painted sandstone arches, sun-bleached broken pillars and a quiet windblown dune horizon. Bright pale warm background clearly separates the very dark creature.
Subject identity: a GIANT BLACK-VIOLET WYRM, massively thick and muscular, sheathed in jagged dark armor plates edged in ACID-GOLD. A broad brutal wedge-shaped dragon head, huge forked angular crown horns, narrow blazing acid-yellow eyes, ivory fangs and heavy jaw muscles. It aggressively LUNGES LEFT out of a compressed broad S-coil across the desert foreground, roaring with wide-open jaws and sharp fangs. Its long entire body and tapering tail remain clearly visible. Strictly a LEGLESS WINGLESS serpent: absolutely NO legs, NO arms, NO hands, NO feet, NO wings and NO fins.
Palette: obsidian black-violet scales and acid-gold armor/eyes against low-contrast pale ochre and cream sandstone. Mature monumental menace, explosive forward force; no gore.

Scene: cool PALE TURQUOISE STORM CLOUDS in a vast sky, soft distant floating rock silhouettes and a luminous silver-blue break in the clouds. Quiet low-detail painted cloud forms give the warm creature a strong clean backdrop.
Subject identity: a FIERY CRIMSON-AND-GOLD AMPHIPTERE, a powerful thick serpentine scaled dragon with exactly TWO ENORMOUS FEATHERED WINGS near its shoulders. A broad leonine-reptilian dragon muzzle (NOT a bird beak), swept heavy golden bull-like horns, fierce amber eyes and huge exposed ivory fangs. It surges upward RIGHT with wings flared in a commanding aggressive attack pose, jaws roaring with no breath effect. The ENTIRE creature's outer bounding shape, from far-left wing tip to far-right wing tip and highest feather to lowest tail tip, must occupy NO MORE THAN 75% of image width and 75% of image height. Leave a clear uninterrupted pale turquoise background border of at least 12% on ALL FOUR SIDES. Both COMPLETE feathered wings are fully visible, with every feather tip away from the image edges. The wings are huge relative to its body but the view is far enough back to fit them. Keep head, fangs, detailed crimson/gold scaled body and overall furious pose strong and readable in the center. Do not add frame graphics, borders, panels or vignette; the margin is natural painted sky.
